author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Electricman 2 HS

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host clicks NEW, types a name, clicks ENTER, then SKIP or plays the training, and picks a match. Space starts it.

keys.does: Left and right walk, down slides.
Grab an enemy in front of you.
The superpowers. They use your battery.

tips: Everyone plays on their own PC with their own keys, on one shared screen; only the host's mouse works in the menus.
There is one extra enemy per extra player.
A player out of health stays down until the match ends. The match is lost only when everyone is down.
A friend who leaves is removed and the rest play on.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Electricman 2 HS (Newgrounds, Free World Group version): fight the Tournament of Voltagen as a team with up to 3 friends in one arena, each on their own keys.
